description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git rebase' commands under various options and scenarios. It sets up test repositories, performs rebasing operations with different parameters such as --empty=drop, --empty=keep, --empty=stop, --empty=ask, --keep-empty, --no-keep-empty, and --exec, and verifies expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file identified by a prefix, used for setting up test data.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful completion of the enclosed commands.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting the enclosed commands to fail.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used in testing error conditions.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a specified path does not exist, used to check cleanup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality, used to verify test results.
